description: Create an A/B test as a DRAFT: nobody sees it until start_experiment. 2 to 4 arms, each pointing at a paywall or onboarding flow of this app on the experiment's surface (ids from list_surfaces); one arm may be a holdout with no target (it keeps the live config). Exactly one control; the first arm when none is marked. Defaults: mode notify (report the winner, don't ship it), new users only, the default placement, trial_started as the metric. Only works when the app allows MCP writes.

enrollment.description: Default new: users first seen after the start

hypothesis.description: What you expect to happen and why

is_qa.description: A QA run on test builds. Default false

min_confidence.description: Chance to be best a winner needs. Default 0.95

mode.description: notify (default) reports a winner; auto ships it

targeting.description: Who is eligible; every rule must pass, {} = everyone. Keys: countries (ISO-2), platforms (ios, android, web), app_version_min/max, days_since_install_min/max, billing_states, custom

target_id.description: Paywall or onboarding flow id; omit for the holdout

name: create_experiment
title: Create a draft experiment
